function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a comprehensive, evidence-bounded investigation of the MOVEit Transfer mass-exploitation campaign. Return only facts and relationships supported by the benchmark tools and cite every item using exactly the source IDs those tools provide; do not invent source IDs, entity names, dates, links, or relationship names. Cover: CVE disclosure and vulnerability details; exploitation methods and chronology; deployment and characteristics of LEMURLOOT; victims and affected organizations; public attribution statements, especially any statements linking activity to FIN11 and/or CL0P; extortion infrastructure and any supported links to FIN11/CL0P-linked infrastructure; relevant actors, malware, infrastructure, and dates. Explicitly label each item as verified fact, allegation, analytical assessment, inferred relationship, or unresolved uncertainty where appropriate. Identify contradictions or competing claims, and distinguish direct evidence from inference. Structure the response so it can support a final readable Markdown report plus a fenced JSON object with exactly four arrays named findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions. Each finding must have question, answer, supporting_entities, source_references; each claim must have claim, source_references; each reasoning step must have id, conclusion, premise_entities, premise_relations; each contradiction must have contradiction_id, description, source_references. Source references must be limited to IDs actually returned by benchmark tools."}
function.name: ConductResearch
